description.value: Riddim & Spice is a Caribbean restaurant on Vancouver's lively Commercial Drive, specializing in Jamaican and Caribbean cuisine including slow-cooked oxtail, jerk chicken, and golden flaky patties filled with spiced beef, chicken, or vegetables. Situated on one of the city's most cycling-friendly corridors, it offers both in-person pickup and online delivery ordering. Its hearty, flavour-forward dishes make it a distinctive cultural stop for cyclists rolling through East Vancouver.
